title: Bound heterogeneous orbitwise partial fusion with restored-dirt feedback
body:
## Result

Allow the selected target195/donor521 boundary to use coordinate-orbit blocks of unequal volumes, with a separate partial-fusion choice `k` on each block. The two native child ranks become `f+k` and `f-k`; the exact middle transfer is `B_K y/2`.

For any fixed block-wide feedback adapter with restored donor and arbitrary dirty helpers, at least `k+1` shears are necessary. Relative to the original one ADD, let `W = sum(block_volume * k)`. Extra arithmetic is at least `W`, while the rank-only recursive saving is at most `A delta f^(-alpha) W`, where `delta = 2-2^(1-alpha)` and `A` is one fixed coefficient in matching arithmetic units. Thus this whole heterogeneous-volume family fails the uniform optimistic screen for sufficiently large `f`, even when block volumes and every `k` vary with `f`.

The written proof combines exact Clifford orbit structure, support growth and convexity. This extends the full-fusion endpoint of #3989/#4009 to all partial cuts and their orbitwise combinations.

## Scope

The native calls act on the target before and after an adapter with no recursive calls. Every adapter shear processes one entire chosen block; monomial maps, arbitrary source mixtures, feedback and any finite number of restored dirty helpers are allowed. Blocks are unions of joint Pauli orbits. Cross-block mixing, masked sub-block operations, overlapping native supports, data-dependent partitions and recursive calls inside the adapter remain outside the theorem.

Native wrappers, hosting, precision and routing are granted free only for this optimistic obstruction. No physical supplier, optimal-runtime lower bound, numerical finite threshold without `A`, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Evidence

Publication head: `9cdd8d6f4389d8e8e26b910f4b139e1cc7b86173`.

- Source-authenticated reconstruction of 1,536 literal child columns, 128 joint orbits and the complete intervening dependency region.
- 3,184 complete reduced two-payload basis cases for all `k` at `f=1,2,3,4`, plus 96 heterogeneous-block basis cases and exact direct monomial transfers.
- Four wrong constructions rejected; exact integer support controls and 8,384 high-precision controls supplement the analytic all-f convexity proof.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay and source-pin validation; optimized replay, committed-byte/history and portable-export checks are recorded in the final verification receipt.
- Separate Codex conceptual proof review. This is not independent human or formal-kernel acceptance.

Reproduce with `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/native-orbit-partial-fusion`.
